# TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance

**内边酉 gauge 不变性**

证明往每条内边两个半边插入酉 gauge 及其共轭核后，开放腿上的净收缩与原 netContract 完全相同。

**边界**：不含一般可逆 gauge 分类、canonical MPS/PEPS 物理约定或算法费用。

**覆盖等级**：A

| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10g_rowPacking_gram` | theorem | L9594 | Packing the rows of a matrix into incoming-bond and physical indices expresses its Gram matrix as the sum of the packed tensors' Gram matrices over the physical index. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10g_chainA_zero_matrix` | theorem | L9652 | At a site whose index is zero, the constructed tensor is the matrix obtained by packing the first-site isometric extension. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10g_chainA_mid_matrix` | theorem | L9663 | At a site strictly between the boundaries, the constructed tensor is the matrix obtained by packing the intermediate isometric extension. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10g_chainA_leftCanonical` | theorem | L9676 | The MPS chain assembled from the extended singular-vector blocks is left canonical. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10g_sum_empty_cfg` | theorem | L9707 | For a nonempty chain with zero physical dimension, every real-valued sum over physical configurations is zero. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10g_mpsAmplitude_zero` | theorem | L9714 | On a chain with at least one site and nonzero bond dimension, setting every tensor to zero makes every MPS amplitude zero. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.clause2_clause2` | theorem | L9726 | Every normalized state on at least one site has an exact left-canonical MPS representation with bond dimension equal to the maximum of one and its cut ranks before `n`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10g_clause3_of_one_le_two_tail` | theorem | L9750 | For a normalized state on a nonempty chain, the desired MPS approximation bound holds whenever twice the total discarded squared Schmidt tail is at least one. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10g_clause3_of_cutRank_le` | theorem | L9770 | For a nonempty chain, if every cut rank before `n` is at most a positive bond dimension `D`, there is a bond-`D` MPS satisfying the bound by twice the total discarded squared Schmidt tail. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10g_clause3_of_approximant` | theorem | L9799 | An amplitude function whose cut ranks are at most positive `D` and whose squared error has the required Schmidt-tail bound yields a bond-`D` MPS with the same error bound, for a nonempty chain. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_ofCut` | def | L9832 | The amplitude function obtained from a matrix at cut `c` by splitting each configuration and encoding its prefix and suffix as row and column indices. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutMatrix_ofCut` | theorem | L9839 | Taking the cut matrix of the amplitude function reconstructed from a matrix at the same valid cut recovers that matrix. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_ofCut_cutMatrix` | theorem | L9854 | Reconstructing an amplitude function from its matrix at a valid cut recovers the function. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_ofCut_add` | theorem | L9863 | Reconstruction from a matrix at a valid cut preserves addition. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_ofCut_smul` | theorem | L9870 | Reconstruction from a matrix at a valid cut preserves multiplication by a complex scalar. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutMatrix_add` | theorem | L9877 | The cut-matrix construction preserves addition of amplitude functions. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutMatrix_smul` | theorem | L9884 | The cut-matrix construction preserves multiplication of an amplitude function by a complex scalar. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutMatrix_sub` | theorem | L9890 | The cut-matrix construction preserves subtraction of amplitude functions. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_rk` | def | L9897 | The outer product of a left singular vector with its conjugate, viewed as a square matrix on the output indices. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_rk_apply` | theorem | L9904 | An entry of `g10t_rk A k` is the left singular-vector value at its row times the conjugate value at its column. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_inner_leftSingular` | theorem | L9912 | The inner product of two left singular vectors is one exactly when their indices agree and the corresponding singular value is nonzero, and is zero otherwise. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_rk_conjTranspose` | theorem | L9933 | The outer product matrix associated with a left singular vector is equal to its conjugate transpose. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_rk_mul_rk` | theorem | L9941 | The outer product matrices of distinct left singular vectors multiply to zero, while each such matrix is idempotent. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_projMat` | def | L9995 | The sum of the left singular-vector outer products of the cut matrix whose singular indices are smaller than `D`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_projMat_eq_sum_filter` | theorem | L10002 | The cut projection matrix is the sum of the left singular-vector outer products over the finite set of singular indices smaller than `D`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_projMat_mul_self` | theorem | L10009 | The cut projection matrix is idempotent. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_projMat_conjTranspose` | theorem | L10042 | The cut projection matrix is equal to its conjugate transpose. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_inner_row` | theorem | L10050 | Pairing a left singular vector with a matrix column gives the corresponding singular value times the conjugate right singular-vector entry. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_sum_mul_matrix` | theorem | L10104 | Right multiplication of a finite sum of matrices distributes over that sum. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_rk_mul_matrix` | theorem | L10116 | Left-multiplying a matrix by the outer product of its `k`th left singular vector extracts its `k`th singular component. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_projMat_mul_cutMatrix` | theorem | L10138 | Left multiplication of a cut matrix by its cut projection matrix gives the SVD truncation at `D`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutProj` | def | L10158 | The operator on amplitude functions that left-multiplies their cut matrices by the projection onto the reference state's first `D` left singular components and then reconstructs the functions. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutMatrix_cutProj` | theorem | L10164 | At the projection's own valid cut, the matrix of a projected amplitude function is the projection matrix times the original cut matrix. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutProj_add` | theorem | L10171 | The cut projection operator preserves addition of amplitude functions. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutProj_self` | theorem | L10179 | Applying the same cut projection twice has the same result as applying it once. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutProj_smul` | theorem | L10189 | The cut projection operator preserves multiplication by a complex scalar. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_frob_neg` | theorem | L10196 | Negating a matrix preserves the square of its spectral Frobenius norm. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_trace_cross_zero` | theorem | L10203 | If `A * B` is zero, then the trace of `X` conjugate-transposed times `A`, `B`, and `Y`, in that order, is zero. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_frob_add` | theorem | L10215 | When the trace inner product of `X` and `Y` is zero, the squared spectral Frobenius norm of their sum is the sum of their squared norms. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_frob_proj_le` | theorem | L10230 | Left multiplication by a self-adjoint idempotent matrix cannot increase the squared spectral Frobenius norm. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_frob_pythagoras` | theorem | L10247 | For a self-adjoint idempotent `P`, the squared norm of `M - P * N` splits into the squared norm of `M - P * M` and that of `P * (M - N)`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_error_self` | theorem | L10267 | Projecting the reference state at a valid cut gives a total squared amplitude error equal to that cut's discarded squared Schmidt tail. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_error_step` | theorem | L10280 | Projecting an approximating amplitude function at a valid cut increases its squared error from the reference state by at most that cut's discarded squared Schmidt tail. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_iter` | def | L10321 | The sequence beginning at the reference state and successively applying its cut projections at cuts `n - 1 - k`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_iter_error` | theorem | L10328 | After `k` successive cut projections, the total squared error is bounded by the sum of the discarded squared Schmidt tails at the cuts used in those steps. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_iter_error_final` | theorem | L10351 | For a nonempty chain, the squared error after `n - 1` cut projections is at most twice the total discarded squared Schmidt tail over cuts before `n`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_rk_rank_le` | theorem | L10387 | The outer product matrix of a left singular vector has rank at most one. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_card_lt_le` | theorem | L10398 | The number of indices in `Fin N` whose natural-number values are smaller than `D` is at most `D`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_projMat_rank_le` | theorem | L10409 | The cut projection matrix has rank at most `D`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutProj_cutRank_self` | theorem | L10432 | Projecting at a valid cut makes the resulting amplitude function's rank at that cut at most `D`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_splitJoin_head` | theorem | L10440 | For `j` at most `c`, the first `j` entries of a configuration joined at cut `j` recover its first component. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_splitJoin_tail` | theorem | L10451 | For `j` at most `c`, the entries from `j` onward of a configuration joined at cut `j` recover its second component. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_splitJoin_assoc` | theorem | L10465 | When `j` is at most `c` and `c` is at most `n`, a configuration joined at cut `c` can instead be joined at cut `j` by splitting its prefix again. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_splitJoin_assoc'` | theorem | L10497 | Joining three consecutive configuration blocks first at cut `j` or first within the prefix of length `c` gives the same full configuration, for `j` at most `c` at most `n`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_headEnc` | def | L10525 | The encoded first `j` entries of a configuration encoded by an index of `Fin (d ^ c)`, assuming `j` is at most `c`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_tailEnc` | def | L10531 | The encoded final `c - j` entries of a configuration encoded by an index of `Fin (d ^ c)`, assuming `j` is at most `c`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_joinEnc` | def | L10536 | The index encoding the join of decoded blocks of lengths `j` and `c - j`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_headEnc_joinEnc` | theorem | L10542 | Extracting the encoded head of the join of two encoded configuration blocks recovers the first block's index. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_tailEnc_joinEnc` | theorem | L10551 | Extracting the encoded tail of the join of two encoded configuration blocks recovers the second block's index. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_joinEnc_head_tail` | theorem | L10559 | Joining the encoded head and tail extracted from a configuration index recovers that index. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_joinEncEquiv` | def | L10573 | The equivalence between a pair of encoded configuration blocks of lengths `j` and `c - j` and an encoded configuration of length `c`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_sum_joinEnc` | theorem | L10589 | A sum over encoded configurations of length `c` equals the iterated sum over their encoded head and tail blocks. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_splitJoin_assoc_mid` | theorem | L10600 | Regrouping a configuration at cuts `j` and `c` preserves it when the middle block is taken from the tail of a length-`c` configuration, assuming `j` is at most `c` at most `n`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_leftKron` | def | L10630 | The matrix acting by `P` on the encoded head of length `j` and by the identity on the encoded tail of length `c - j`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_leftKron_apply` | theorem | L10638 | An entry of the extended head matrix is the corresponding entry of `P` when the encoded tails agree, and zero otherwise. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_leftKron_entry` | theorem | L10647 | Applying the extended head matrix to a vector sums over head indices while keeping the output index's encoded tail fixed. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutProj_apply_left` | theorem | L10680 | For `j < c` and `c` at most `n`, evaluating the cut-`j` projection on a configuration joined at `c` is the corresponding entry of the projected cut-`j` matrix after regrouping its blocks. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutProj_entry_lt` | theorem | L10719 | For `j < c` and `c` at most `n`, an entry of the cut-`c` matrix after projection at `j` is a sum over head indices weighted by the cut-`j` projection matrix, with the tail index fixed. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutMatrix_cutProj_of_lt` | theorem | L10778 | For `j < c` and `c` at most `n`, projecting at cut `j` acts on the cut-`c` matrix by left multiplication with the projection matrix extended by the identity on the intervening block. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_cutRank_cutProj_of_lt` | theorem | L10788 | Projection at an earlier cut `j` cannot increase the rank at a later valid cut `c`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_iter_cutRank_aux` | theorem | L10799 | After `k` successive projections, every cut `c` with `n - k` at most `c` and `c < n` has rank at most `D`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_iter_cutRank_le` | theorem | L10821 | For positive `D`, every cut before `n` of the state obtained after `n - 1` successive projections has rank at most `D`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.g10t_trunc_approximant` | theorem | L10832 | For a nonempty chain and positive `D`, there is an approximating amplitude function with every cut rank before `n` at most `D` and squared error at most twice the total discarded squared Schmidt tail. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.TensorNetwork.GaugeInvariance.clause2_clause3` | theorem | L10844 | Every normalized state on at least one site has, for each positive bond dimension `D`, an MPS approximation with total squared amplitude error at most twice the sum of its discarded squared Schmidt tails over cuts before `n`. |
